title: Independent synthetic freelance website quote correspondence cases
frozenFrom: CONTRACT.md before reading core.mjs or embeddings.mjs
evaluationNotes: These are human-authored semantic expectations, not observed model outputs or customer data.
Run actual model inference and retain every candidate score, rank, recommendedB and ambiguity result.
For clear cases, measure whether the expected candidate ranks first; report the numerator and denominator.
For reject and ambiguous cases, report observed behavior separately. Do not fold these labels into a misleading exact-match accuracy metric.
The core contract uses a 0.35 recommendation threshold and a top-two gap below 0.08 for ambiguity; a human label does not guarantee the model satisfies either threshold.
Correspondence identifies the type of work. Quantity, exclusions, retention terms and maintenance periods can still make the scopes different.
Every suggested match requires explicit human confirmation, including clear high-similarity cases.
Do not tune the model or thresholds on these frozen examples and then present the result as independent validation.

cases.source: Turn the approved screen designs into a working website that remains usable on phones, tablets, and desktop computers.

candidates.description: Produce a visual identity package with logo variants and brand colours.
Implement the supplied layouts with responsive behaviour across screen sizes.
Audit an existing website and deliver a mobile usability report.

cases.rationale: The deliverable is implementation of supplied designs across devices. A visual identity or an audit report does not supply that deliverable.

cases.source: Let visitors choose an available consultation slot on the website, using the business's existing Calendly account.

candidates.description: Design a bespoke scheduling platform with staff rosters, resource allocation and a new booking database.
Create a public events listing with dates, locations and links to event details.
Connect and embed the client's current third-party appointment scheduler so customers can book online.

cases.rationale: The source reuses an existing service. Building a new scheduling platform changes the architecture and scope.

cases.source: Transfer the text and images from 12 existing pages into the replacement website.

candidates.description: Populate the new site's templates using content taken from 8 pages of the old site.
Write original copy and select stock photography for 12 new pages.
Review 12 live pages and supply a list of broken links.

reviewReasons: Description page count changes from 12 to 8; flag descriptionNumbersChanged.

cases.rationale: Migration corresponds to migration even when the quantity differs. Matching a number alone would incorrectly select a different service.

cases.source: Send website enquiries to the owner's email address. Do not retain submitted messages on the web server.

candidates.description: Add telephone and email links to the contact page.
Implement an enquiry form that emails the owner and stores every submission in a server database.
Connect newsletter subscriptions to an email marketing service.

reviewReasons: The source prohibits message storage and the candidate requires it; flag a negation or exclusion change and require manual scope review.

cases.rationale: Both describe the enquiry form workflow, but the storage condition conflicts. Correspondence does not establish equivalent scope.

cases.source: After launch, show the office team how to edit page text, replace photos and publish news themselves, and leave a recording they can revisit.

candidates.description: A designer will make requested text and image changes on the client's behalf each month.
Run a workshop about writing persuasive social media posts and measuring campaign results.
Deliver a recorded CMS handover session covering everyday content publishing for nontechnical administrators.

cases.rationale: The expected deliverable equips staff to maintain content themselves, with a reusable recording. Ongoing outsourced editing is a different service.

cases.source: Reduce the time visitors wait for the main page content by resizing oversized photographs and deferring scripts that are not needed immediately.

candidates.description: Research target search phrases and rewrite page titles and meta descriptions.
Optimise image delivery and JavaScript loading to improve the site's initial rendering performance.
Replace the current photographs and redesign the page typography to refresh the visual style.

cases.rationale: The work changes loading behavior and asset delivery. Search copy and aesthetic redesign do not meet this performance objective.

cases.source: Set up a way for the owner to see where website visitors come from and which enquiry button they press.

candidates.description: Configure web analytics with acquisition reporting and conversion events for contact calls to action.
Submit the sitemap to a search engine and inspect indexing coverage.
Route submitted enquiry forms to the correct sales representative based on location.

cases.rationale: The requested output is visitor and interaction measurement. Search indexing and lead assignment address different business operations.

cases.source: Give staff a browser-based dashboard where they can change opening hours and service descriptions without asking a developer.

candidates.description: Rewrite the opening-hours and service-description copy for the public website.
Publish monthly articles describing the company's services.
Provide a PDF handbook explaining how to request website changes from the developer.

reviewReasons: None of the candidates supplies a self-service editing interface. Leave unmatched after manual review.

cases.rationale: Shared vocabulary about updating content does not establish the required capability. Record whether the model incorrectly recommends a candidate.

cases.source: For 12 months after handover, install security updates and check uptime every month.

candidates.description: Provide a 12-month care plan with security patches and availability checks every 3 months.
Provide a 6-month care plan with monthly security patches and availability checks.
Perform a one-time security scan immediately before launch.

reviewReasons: One plan changes frequency and the other changes contract duration. Neither is equivalent; require manual review of both.
Description numbers differ in both plausible candidates.

cases.rationale: Duration and frequency are separate scope dimensions. A single score cannot decide which compromise the buyer intends.

cases.source: Create the visual design for a campaign landing page and turn the approved design into a live responsive page.

candidates.description: Prepare an original landing-page layout in Figma, including desktop and mobile design files.
Develop and publish a responsive landing page from design files supplied by the client.
Write advertising headlines and calls to action for the campaign.

reviewReasons: The source bundles design and implementation, while separate candidates cover only one part each.
The current one-to-one mapping cannot represent this split completely; preserve the unmatched row and explain the limitation.

cases.rationale: Both candidates are partial counterparts. Automatically accepting either as full equivalence would hide a real scope difference.
